mentions.name: viva
mentions.description: This tool helps author and review documentation. Users specify the kind of doc they want and attach links, files, or repo paths; it then asks clarifying questions until it has the data it needs, drafts the doc, and provides a review interface where users can approve, request more info, request changes, or make direct edits, iterating until all sections are approved.
mentions.problem: Working with agents generates a lot of markdown input and output that needs to be authored and reviewed as documents.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working with agents generates a lot of markdown input and output. So I'm working on viva, a tool to help author and review docs.

You tell it what kind of doc you want, attach any necessary links/files/repo paths/etc, then it asks you clarifying questions until it has the data it needs. Then it authors a doc and give you a review interface. You can approve, request more info, request changes, make direct edits, etc.
